name: Gyeran-jjim (Korean Volcano Steamed Eggs)
whyItWorks: Eggs whisked with kelp/anchovy or chicken broth and steamed until fluffy and cloud-like with a drop of sesame oil.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Simmer whisked eggs and salted chicken broth in a small pot for 5-6 minutes covered, drizzle with 1 drop toasted sesame oil, and skip the raw scallion garnish.
